description: Morning Wire digest manifest. The bot reads this first to understand all content without scanning HTML files.

static_pages.purpose: Interactive maps for India, US, Russia, Middle East

digests.summary: Election day and its immediate aftermath.

stories.headline: Democrats sweep the midterms
Strait of Hormuz: tankers hit mines
Russia bombed a Ukrainian aid center. 42 dead.
France: 600,000 people protested

digests.summary: The day after. Markets react. Congress prepares.

stories.headline: Markets crashed
Democrats plan investigations into Trump's family
Hegseth impeachment effort advances
Alito won't retire
Trump cuts $4 billion in Israel aid

digests.summary: A new chief of staff, new strikes on Iran, and a measles record.

stories.headline: Stephen Miller named White House chief of staff
U.S. carries out minor strikes on Iran
U.S. measles cases pass 5,000
Paraguay's president is out after a bank collapse
AI chip stocks bounce after the crash

digests.summary: A press secretary offer, a deadlocked New Zealand vote, and two peace plans waiting on a reply.

stories.headline: Trump offers Dana White the press secretary job
New Zealand election is too close to call
Qatar's Hormuz plan still has no takers
Russia-Ukraine talks set for Tuesday in Abu Dhabi
Dozens killed at a Yemen market. Who struck it is disputed.

digests.summary: Strikes before talks. A spy scandal at Nvidia. COP31 opens. The midterm count continues.

stories.headline: Russia and Ukraine trade strikes before Abu Dhabi talks
Nvidia spy scandal deepens
COP31 opens in Antalya
Democrats reach 254 seats, still counting

digests.summary: Hegseth faces impeachment articles. Abu Dhabi talks underway. Markets bounce back. Pentagon evacuates a second U.K. base.

stories.headline: Hegseth impeachment articles introduced in Congress
Russia and Ukraine hold talks in Abu Dhabi as U.S. mediates
Stock market rebounds after three-day plunge
Pentagon evacuates second U.K. base over Iran threat
Qatar PM says Trump, Vance open to Iran deal talks

digests.summary: Russia escalates attacks on Ukraine. Hegseth defends his record. Nvidia scandal deepens. Religious leaders call for AI weapons regulation. Inflation data unnerves the Fed.

stories.headline: Russia launches massive drone attack on Zelensky's hometown
Hegseth lashes out at 'political show' over impeachment
Nvidia shares plummet as scandal deepens
Religious leaders demand international regulation of 'killer robots'
U.S. inflation exceeds expectations, Fed rate hike likely

digests.summary: Abu Dhabi talks end with a prisoner exchange deal. Three tankers on fire in Hormuz. Jim Jordan elected House Minority Leader. Congo confirms second-largest Ebola outbreak on record.

stories.headline: Russia and Ukraine agree to prisoner exchange as Abu Dhabi talks end
Three tankers catch fire in Strait of Hormuz. Bessent moves family to military base.
Jim Jordan elected House Minority Leader
Congo Ebola outbreak is second-largest on record
Democrat wins Mississippi Senate race, majority grows to 55

digests.summary: FAA grounds all U.S. flights for five hours after a telecom outage. Trump announces a trilateral summit with Xi and Putin at APEC. Turkey and Qatar sign a mutual defense pact. IS fighters kill 44 civilians in Ebola-hit DR Congo. Ukraine says Russia refused to discuss ceasefire at Abu Dhabi talks.

stories.headline: FAA grounds all U.S. flights after telecommunications outage
Trump to meet Xi and Putin at APEC. Nuclear arms and Iran on the agenda.
Turkey and Qatar sign mutual defense pact in Istanbul
IS-linked fighters kill 44 civilians in Ebola-hit DR Congo
Ukraine says Russia refused to discuss ceasefire at Abu Dhabi talks

digests.summary: Jensen Huang resigns from Nvidia. Iran claims it hit a U.S. radar in Bahrain. Van Hollen challenges Schumer. U.S. envoys meet Putin. Microsoft outage hits millions.

stories.headline: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO
Iran claims it destroyed U.S. radar in Bahrain
Van Hollen challenges Schumer for Senate majority leader
Kushner and Witkoff meet Putin in Moscow. Europe to join future talks.
Microsoft outage disrupts services worldwide

digests.summary: Iran launches drones at Bahrain's Riffa Air Base for the second time in three days. Trump departs for APEC and a trilateral meeting with Xi and Putin in Shenzhen. Ukraine launches its largest drone attack on Russia since the war began. The House tables Hegseth impeachment articles 211-204. Senate Democrats confirm Schumer as incoming majority leader.

stories.headline: Iran attacks Bahrain air base for second time in three days
Trump departs for Asia. Trilateral with Xi and Putin set for Wednesday.
Ukraine launches largest drone attack on Russia since the war began
House tables Hegseth impeachment articles by seven votes
Senate Democrats confirm Schumer as incoming majority leader

digests.summary: Russia strikes both Kyiv bridges with ballistic missiles. Ukraine hits the Kerch Bridge. U.S. intelligence warns Iran is planning a dirty bomb attack on Washington. Trump meets ASEAN leaders in Manila before the Shenzhen trilateral with Xi and Putin. Japan scrambles jets after Russian aircraft violate its airspace. U.K. sanctions eight Israeli settlement companies.

stories.headline: Russia hits both Kyiv bridges. Ukraine strikes the Kerch Bridge.
U.S. intelligence: Iran is planning a dirty bomb attack on Washington
Trump in Manila for ASEAN. Shenzhen trilateral set for Thursday.
Japan scrambles jets after Russian aircraft violate its airspace
U.K. sanctions eight Israeli companies over West Bank settlements

digests.summary: Iran widens Gulf attacks, striking Kuwait's Ali Al Salem Air Base after the U.S. hit an IRGC missile site on Qeshm Island. Trump lands in Shenzhen as Xi meets him at the airport. Trilateral with Putin set for Thursday. Western intelligence says Putin plans to fight through winter. Ethiopia and Eritrea mass troops along their shared border. WHO demands unobstructed aid access to Gaza for its fourth winter of war.

stories.headline: Iran strikes U.S. base in Kuwait. U.S. had hit an IRGC missile site a day earlier.
Trump lands in Shenzhen. Xi meets him at the airport. Trilateral with Putin is Thursday.
Western intelligence: Putin plans to fight through winter
Ethiopia and Eritrea mass troops along border as war fears grow
WHO demands unobstructed aid access to Gaza for its fourth winter of war

digests.summary: The Shenzhen trilateral ends with a joint statement on strategic stability and no concrete commitments on Iran or Ukraine. Ukraine hits the Kerch Bridge for a third time in four days. Hegseth flies to Caracas and signs a military partnership with Venezuela. The ICJ rules Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya. Denmark's parliament approves an Arctic security pact with the U.S. and Greenland.

stories.headline: Trump, Xi, and Putin conclude Shenzhen summit with joint statement. No Iran or Ukraine commitments.
Ukraine strikes Kerch Bridge for third time in four days. Rail traffic halted.
Hegseth in Caracas. U.S. and Venezuela sign military partnership.
ICJ rules Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya
Denmark approves Arctic security pact with U.S. and Greenland

digests.summary: Russia fires 30 ballistic missiles at Kyiv overnight, Putin rules out ceasefire. COP31 misses its Friday deadline, deadlocked over fossil fuels. Senate Republicans drop $350 billion Iran war defense bill. Pentagon study contradicts Trump officials on munitions shortfall. South Korea's Supreme Court overturns Han Duck-soo sentence.

stories.headline: Russia fires 30 ballistic missiles at Kyiv overnight. Putin rules out ceasefire talks.
COP31 misses its deadline. Talks deadlocked over fossil fuel language.
Senate Republicans suspend $350 billion Iran war defense bill
Pentagon study: Iran war has deepened munitions shortfall, contradicting White House
South Korea's Supreme Court overturns Han Duck-soo sentence. Case sent back.

digests.summary: Zelensky reveals U.S. raised Donbas-for-NATO idea. SpaceX catches Starship upper stage for the first time. Two more tankers hit mines in Hormuz. UPS and Copa planes collide at Miami airport. Iran rejects IAEA uranium enrichment halt.

stories.headline: Zelensky says U.S. proposed Donbas-for-NATO deal
SpaceX catches Starship upper stage in first-ever tower catch
Two more tankers hit mines in the Strait of Hormuz
UPS cargo plane and Copa Airlines jet collide at Miami airport
Iran rejects IAEA demand to halt uranium enrichment

digests.summary: COP31 ends after three days of overtime with a weak compromise rejected by Gulf states and Russia. NATO holds emergency session over Poland missile incident, Rutte lands in Warsaw. Iran announces 72-hour ultimatum to close the Strait of Hormuz, oil hits $141. Ukraine strikes Belgorod, Russia orders partial reserve call-up. Ethiopia and Eritrea exchange artillery fire along their border for the first time since 2000.

stories.headline: COP31 ends with a weak compromise. Gulf states and Russia reject the final text.
NATO holds emergency call after Poland missile incident. Rutte lands in Warsaw.
Iran announces 72-hour ultimatum to close the Strait of Hormuz. Oil spikes above $140.
Ukraine strikes Belgorod in retaliation. Russia orders partial reserve call-up.
Ethiopia and Eritrea exchange artillery fire along their border. First clashes since 2000.

digests.summary: Russia fires 400+ drones and 110 missiles at Ukraine, two land in Poland and NATO calls it a grave violation. COP31 enters second day of overtime with no deal. Trump threatens Iran over dirty bomb intelligence. UK and EU sign post-Brexit reset deal. Germany and Qatar sign broad partnership with 15B euro investment pledge.

stories.headline: Russia fires 400 drones and 110 missiles at Ukraine. Two land in Poland. NATO calls it a grave violation.
Trump threatens military action over Iran dirty bomb intelligence. White House says no credible threat.
COP31 enters second day of overtime. No deal in sight on fossil fuels or climate finance.
UK and EU sign post-Brexit reset deal in Brussels. Food trade, emissions, youth travel.
Germany and Qatar sign broad partnership deal. Qatar pledges 15 billion euros and offers to mediate Iran war.

digests.summary: Iran's Hormuz ultimatum enters Day 2 with the strait effectively closed and the U.S. issuing a counter-proposal. NATO holds an emergency North Atlantic Council session in Brussels over Russian missiles in Poland. Ukraine strikes a Russian cargo ship in the Baltic and a Russian warship in Libya. The African Union convenes over Ethiopia-Eritrea border clashes but neither side agrees to direct talks. U.S. announces new AI chip export controls requiring permits for overseas firms to supply compute to Chinese customers.

stories.headline: Iran's Hormuz ultimatum enters Day 2. U.S. rejects terms and issues counter-proposal.
NATO holds emergency session in Brussels over Russian missiles in Poland.
Ukraine strikes Russian ship in the Baltic and a warship in a Libyan port.
African Union convenes over Ethiopia-Eritrea. Neither side agrees to direct talks.
U.S. announces new AI chip export controls. Overseas firms need permits to sell compute to China.

digests.summary: Iran orders Hormuz closed further day by day and sets seven conditions, as Qatar seeks a last-ditch deal. Russia threatens NATO member Estonia with open war over border closure. Trump reinstates Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO after personally calling the board. RSF drones strike Khartoum for a fourth day, killing four and damaging a UN building. NATO warns Russia may launch a nuclear-armed satellite by December.

stories.headline: Iran orders Hormuz closed further day by day. Sets seven conditions. Qatar seeks a last-ditch deal.
Russia threatens NATO member Estonia with open war over border closure and alleged drone support for Ukraine.
Jensen Huang returns as Nvidia CEO after Trump personally intervened with the board.
RSF drones strike Khartoum for a fourth day, killing four and damaging a UN building. An RSF commander defects.
NATO warns Russia may launch a nuclear-armed satellite by December. Rutte says collective defense extends to space.

digests.summary: Iran's Hormuz blockade enters Day 4 as two more tankers hit mines and Saudi air defenses intercept drones over Ras Tanura. Ukraine strikes two Russian oil refineries in Samara Oblast, cutting Russia's crude processing 45 percent for the month, and Putin vows retaliation despite Trump requests to stop. Russia arrests Murmansk Governor Andrei Chibis on embezzlement charges, the first sitting governor detained since the full-scale invasion. Dozens are feared trapped after a gold mine collapses in Indonesia. Trump says a pardon for Jensen Huang is always an option.

stories.headline: Iran's Hormuz blockade enters Day 4. Two tankers hit mines. Saudi Arabia intercepts drones over Ras Tanura.
Ukraine strikes two Russian oil refineries. Putin vows retaliation despite Trump requests to stop.
Russia arrests Murmansk governor on embezzlement charges. First sitting governor detained since invasion.
Dozens feared trapped after gold mine collapses in Indonesia.
Trump says a pardon for Jensen Huang is always an option. Governance critics push back.

digests.summary: Iran's Hormuz blockade enters Day 5 as an Iranian drone attack kills two Italian contractors in Kuwait and Houthis claim a strike on Ras Tanura. Russia fires ballistic missiles and 113 drones at Ukraine overnight, killing at least three in Kharkiv. Trump meets NATO Secretary General Rutte at Mar-a-Lago on Thanksgiving. The administration proposes new Section 301 tariffs on 14 trading partners, drawing pushback from China and the EU. Jensen Huang contradicts Trump's account of his reinstatement and congressional hearings are set.

stories.headline: Iran's Hormuz blockade enters Day 5. Kuwait drone attack kills two Italian contractors. Houthis claim strike on Ras Tanura.
Russia fires ballistic missiles and 113 drones at Ukraine overnight. At least three killed in Kharkiv.
Trump meets NATO chief Rutte at Mar-a-Lago on Thanksgiving. Kushner says large prisoner exchange is coming soon.
Trump proposes new tariffs on 14 trading partners under Section 301. China and EU push back.
Jensen Huang tells Nvidia staff the board reinstated him on its own. Trump disputes the account. Congressional hearings set.
